evals.prompt: 我们的项目里有 4 种不同的用户状态模型，分散在认证、权限、订单、通知四个模块里，每个都有自己的枚举和转换逻辑。帮我分析一下有没有结构统一的机会。
evals.expected_output: Produces a Structural Abstraction report analyzing the four representations, identifies hidden invariants or divergent business rules, classifies the opportunity through the Admissibility Gate, and does not modify code.

assertions.text: Compares the four representations side by side with concrete evidence (fields, invariants, lifecycle transitions).
Classifies the proposal as validated, unproven, false abstraction, or pragmatic sequencing problem.
Passes each candidate through the Admissibility Gate with mandatory proof obligations.
Does not modify code or production configuration.
Produces an HTML report or explicitly provides the analysis path.

evals.prompt: 帮我在这个项目的 abstraction-architect skill 上做点改进，直接改代码。
evals.expected_output: Refuses to modify code without explicit authorization, explains that analysis-only mode is the default, and asks the user to review a transition plan before any implementation.

assertions.text: Does not modify any source files, tests, or configuration.
States that code changes require explicit user authorization after reviewing a plan.
Offers to produce an analysis or transition handoff instead of direct implementation.
Respects the authorization boundary between analysis and execution modes.

evals.prompt: 我有一段重复的适配器代码，把 XML 转 JSON、JSON 转 YAML、YAML 转 XML，到处都是。帮我看看能不能抽象。
evals.expected_output: Analyzes the adapter explosion as structural pressure, formulates a canonical intermediate representation hypothesis, identifies what complexity would disappear and what new complexity is introduced, finds at least one counterexample or meaningful difference, and classifies confidence.

assertions.text: Identifies the adapter/conversion explosion as a structural pressure signal.
Proposes a hidden invariant hypothesis (canonical representation or transformation protocol).
Names at least one case that looks similar but must remain distinct.
Estimates complexity deletion (branches, adapters, tests removed) and new complexity introduced.
Classifies confidence and states missing evidence.

evals.prompt: 帮我做一下这个项目的架构审查，看看有没有深层的结构性问题。
evals.expected_output: Performs a Full Architecture Analysis with structural pressure map, evidence ledger, candidate proposals with Admissibility Gate classification, rejected/deferred abstractions section, and an interactive HTML report.

assertions.text: Produces a structural pressure map showing representation duplication, conversion glue, or orchestration hotspots.
Includes a Rejected or Deferred Abstractions section (mandatory).
Separates observed evidence from inference and unknowns in the evidence ledger.
Each proposal card includes concrete evidence with file/symbol references.
Does not present architecture diagrams implying facts not supported by inspection.

evals.prompt: 我们有个 God object 做中心调度，所有模块都依赖它。帮我看看能不能拆。
evals.expected_output: Analyzes the coordinator as a structural pressure signal, evaluates whether local composition can replace central coordination, identifies which coordination responsibilities are genuinely global (transactions, security) vs which could compose locally, and provides a transition seam.

assertions.text: Examines whether local composition can replace central coordination.
Identifies which responsibilities genuinely require central coordination (e.g., transactions, rate limiting).
Proposes a transition seam (adapter boundary, facade, staged API, or module replacement boundary).
Does not recommend broad rewrite without a transition seam and rollback mechanism.
Classifies the proposal through the Admissibility Gate.
